370186.title: Buyeo Saturday Gugak Series: Yujongjimi
370186.overview: A weekly Saturday programme of Korean traditional music from the Buyeo county gugak orchestra, in the old Baekje capital. At 2,000 won it is one of the cheapest ways anywhere in Korea to hear a full traditional ensemble.

385577.title: Icheon Intangible Heritage Centre: Turtle, Turtle, Come and Play
385577.overview: A free resident programme at Icheon's intangible-heritage training centre, where designated master practitioners perform and teach the region's traditional arts.

374423.title: Namwon Gugak Concert with Tea and Talk: Dadam
374423.venue: Yeeumheon Hall, National Gugak Center Minsok Branch
374423.overview: Traditional music paired with tea and conversation at the national folk-music institute in Namwon, the home town of the Chunhyang story and a centre of pansori tradition. Free admission.

372366.title: Saturday Gugak Fairy Tales
372366.overview: A children's storytelling concert held every Saturday afternoon in a hanok-style hall built for natural acoustics — no amplification, just the instruments in the room. Open to anyone over 12 months old, and an easy entry point for families with no background in Korean music.

379182.title: Raftsmen: Jeongseon Arirang Saturday Series
379182.overview: Jeongseon Arirang is the mountain-village variant of Korea's best-known folk song, and this weekly show tells the story of the log raftsmen who once floated timber down the Han River. The ticket price comes back to you as local vouchers, so it is effectively free.

379141.title: Ansan City Gugak Orchestra: Thursday Bono Concerts

379831.title: Jeonju Signature Production: Byeolhyangdanjyeon (Outdoor Changgeuk)
379831.venue: Jeonju Hanbyeok Cultural Center outdoor stage
379831.overview: Madang changgeuk — Korean opera staged in the round, outdoors, the way it was performed in village courtyards before theatres existed. Jeonju is the traditional heartland of pansori, and this is the city's flagship production.

389157.title: Arirang Museum Special Exhibition: Memories of Coal, People Who Mined the Light
389157.overview: Jeongseon was coal country, and this exhibition at the Arirang Museum traces the mining families whose work and songs shaped the region.

390804.title: Seolleung Art Hall Traditional Vocal Series: Jwachang, Deep Love
390804.overview: Jwachang is the seated style of Korean traditional song, performed without the theatrics of stage pansori — an intimate form best heard in a small hall like this one in Gangnam.

390130.title: World Music Theatre Festival: Changgeuk at the Centre
390130.venue: National Theater of Korea (Haeoreum, Daloreum and Haneul stages)
390130.overview: A festival built around changgeuk, Korean opera sung in pansori style, with invited productions from Korea and abroad across all three stages of the National Theater at the foot of Namsan.

393100.title: Saturday Masterpieces (Toyo Myeongpum)
393100.price: A seat 30,000 won · B seat 20,000 won
393100.overview: The National Gugak Center's flagship weekly showcase, and the single best introduction to Korean traditional performing arts for a visitor. Every Saturday the programme moves through court music, folk song, dance and pieces on the UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage list, performed by the country's leading musicians. Explicitly programmed for Korean and international audiences alike.

393102.title: Saturday Gugak Fairy Tales
393102.overview: A children's theatre programme that teaches Korean musical sensibility through story, held every Saturday afternoon in a hanok sarangbang hall with natural acoustics. Suitable for anyone over 12 months old, so the whole family can attend together.

394712.title: Dancing Women: You Are Living in Barbaretta Now (ver. 2)
394712.venue: Seoul Namsan Gugakdang outdoor yard, Namsangol Hanok Village
394712.overview: Contemporary dance staged in the courtyard of a traditional hanok village in central Seoul — the setting is half the experience, with the city rising behind the tiled roofs.

389673.title: Brunch Concert Atrium: National Gugak Orchestra Youth Ensemble
389673.overview: A late-morning concert by the youth training ensemble of the National Gugak Orchestra, held at the museum beside Seonnongdan — the altar where Joseon kings performed the royal ploughing rite.

392778.title: National Changgeuk Company: Heungbo Splits the Gourd
392778.venue: Daloreum Theater, National Theater of Korea
392778.overview: A concert-format staging of Heungbuga, one of the five surviving pansori epics, built so that first-time audiences can follow it easily. The story of the poor brother rewarded by a swallow is the most beloved comic tale in the repertoire.

393509.title: Chungju Ureuk Gugak Orchestra: NEW WAVE
393509.overview: The orchestra is named after Ureuk, the sixth-century musician credited with developing the gayageum zither, who is tied to this region. Free admission.

391332.title: Surim New Wave 2026: Chu Da-hye, Eotsum
391332.price: 30,000 won (50% off for artists, repeat visitors and Dongdaemun-gu residents)
391332.overview: Chu Da-hye works from Korean shamanic ritual song, reshaping it into something closer to contemporary art music. Part of a series backing musicians who push gugak into new territory.

392950.title: Pansori Story Concert: Jara the Turtle
392950.overview: A family retelling of Sugungga, one of the five pansori epics, following the turtle sent to find a rabbit whose liver will cure the Dragon King. Pitched at children, and a painless way for adults to meet pansori for the first time.

393103.title: Changjak Orchestra: The Performer and the Composer III
393103.price: A seat 30,000 won · B seat 20,000 won
393103.overview: Six players — geomungo, gayageum, piri, ajaeng, daegeum and haegeum — perform works they composed themselves, reviving the older tradition in which performer and composer were the same person.

393988.title: Seongnam City Gugak Orchestra: 75th Regular Concert
393988.price: R seat 10,000 won · S seat 5,000 won

396809.title: Chuncheon Chamber Festival: Haegeum Duo, Our Melodies
396809.overview: The haegeum is a two-string vertical fiddle with a famously voice-like tone; this recital pairs two players in the intimate setting of a Chuncheon chamber hall.

396876.title: Yanggeum and Sanjo: An Outing
396876.overview: The yanggeum is Korea's hammered dulcimer, rarely given a programme of its own. Free, in the National Gugak Center's naturally amplified hanok hall.

391347.title: Kim Han-baek Sogeum Recital II: Salt Warehouse Project
391347.price: 20,000 won (50% off for students, 30% for arts pass holders)
391347.overview: The sogeum is the smallest of the Korean transverse bamboo flutes, with a bright, piercing tone that carries over a full orchestra.

393507.title: Gimpo: National Gugak Center Tour — The Joy and Spirit of Korea
393507.price: R seat 20,000 won · S seat 10,000 won
393507.overview: Part of the National Gugak Center's touring programme, which takes the Seoul institution's musicians to regional halls each year.

393714.title: Pohang: Arirang Ensemble of the Choi Jae-hyung Koryo-saram School — Primorsky Arirang
393714.overview: Performed by ethnic Korean musicians from the Russian Far East, descendants of families who emigrated in the 19th century and were later deported to Central Asia. Their Arirang carries a different accent from the songs sung in Korea. Free admission.

393727.title: Cheonan Chungnam Gugak Orchestra: 92nd Regular Concert

393991.title: Gwangju Metropolitan Gugak Orchestra: Bardo, Moonlight Blessing
393991.price: S seat 20,000 won · A seat 10,000 won

394035.title: Jeonju Changgeuk: That Name, Chunhyang
394035.venue: Moak Hall, Sori Arts Center of Jeonbuk
394035.overview: Chunhyangga is the most performed of the pansori epics — a love story that doubles as a protest against abuse of power — staged here as full changgeuk opera in the city most associated with the tradition.

394970.title: Kim Chang-jo Sanjo Festival
394970.overview: Sanjo is the great solo improvisational form of Korean music, and Kim Chang-jo is credited with creating the gayageum version in the late 19th century. The festival is held at the theme park built on his home ground.

396684.title: Gugak Archive Symposium: Culture, the Arts and Artificial Intelligence II

392781.title: National Folk Gugak Center: The Goblin House Cart Song
392781.venue: Haneul Theater, National Theater of Korea
392781.overview: An invited production at the World Music Theatre Festival: a new gugak music-drama drawing on the legends of Jirisan, told with the humour and consolation characteristic of the Namwon storytelling tradition.

393487.title: Daejeon Yeonjeong Gugak Orchestra: Saturday Gugak
393487.overview: A weekly Saturday series at Daejeon's municipal gugak institute, at a token 2,000 won.

393491.title: Changwon Changgeuk: Salome
393491.price: R seat 40,000 won · S seat 30,000 won
393491.overview: Wilde's Salome reworked as changgeuk — Korean opera sung in pansori voice. An unusually direct example of how the form is being used for material far outside its traditional repertoire.

395333.title: Namdo Gugak Center Saturday Series: Park Jeong-uk's Complete Baebaengigut
395333.venue: Jinak Hall, National Namdo Gugak Center
395333.overview: Baebaengigut is a narrative song form from the northwest, performed here in full by a designated master singer. On Jindo island, itself a centre of folk music tradition. Free admission.

394713.title: Seoul Namsan Gugakdang X SIDance: Trajectory of Return
394713.venue: Crown Haitai Hall, Seoul Namsan Gugakdang
394713.overview: A collaboration between the Namsan traditional-music hall and the Seoul International Dance Festival.

396372.title: Lee Seung-hee Gayageum Recital II: Jeongjin

394715.title: Seoul Namsan Gugakdang X SIDance: Body Rotation Meeting Shamanic Music
394715.venue: Crown Haitai Hall, Seoul Namsan Gugakdang, Namsangol Hanok Village
394715.overview: Contemporary dance set to muak — the ritual music of Korean shamanism — in a hanok village hall.

391348.title: Surim New Wave 2026: Jeong Eun-hye, Eot-Pulse

392783.title: Gwangju Metropolitan Changgeuk Company: Huigyeongnu Banghoedo
392783.venue: Daloreum Theater, National Theater of Korea
392783.overview: Changgeuk built around a 16th-century painting of a scholars' gathering at the Huigyeongnu pavilion in Gwangju.

393619.title: Busan Metropolitan Gugak Orchestra: 237th Regular Concert

392772.title: Orchestra Series I: A Chronicle of Concertos
392772.venue: Haeoreum Theater, National Theater of Korea

392784.title: Badaksori Pansori Factory: Haenyeo Detective Hong Seol-rok
392784.venue: Haneul Theater, National Theater of Korea
392784.overview: A detective story told in pansori, with a Jeju haenyeo — one of the island's free-diving women — as the sleuth.

393002.title: National Changgeuk Company: Gwito, The Rabbit's Trials
393002.overview: The National Changgeuk Company's acclaimed retelling of Sugungga, the rabbit-and-turtle epic, relocated to a modern frame.

392775.title: Complete Pansori: September
392775.venue: Daloreum Theater, National Theater of Korea
392775.overview: The National Theater's long-running monthly series in which a single singer performs one of the five pansori epics in full — a feat that can run past three hours, accompanied only by a drum. The purest form in which to hear pansori.

394716.title: Seoul Namsan Gugakdang X SIDance: Every Living Moment
394716.venue: Crown Haitai Hall, Seoul Namsan Gugakdang

395274.title: Daegu: Kim Bo-hye Haegeum Recital II

395331.title: Namdo Gugak Center Saturday Series: A Feast of Gugak
395331.venue: Jinak Hall, National Namdo Gugak Center
395331.overview: The resident ensemble's own programme in the Saturday series on Jindo island.

393099.title: K-Sori Platform: The Five Pansori Epics with Commentary — Choi Hyun-ju's Dongchoje Heungboga
393099.overview: Pansori performed with spoken commentary between passages, which makes the form far easier to follow without Korean.

396223.title: Kang Eun-il Haegeum Recital 31: Sanjo Project IV — I Am Kim Yeong-jae
396223.overview: Kang Eun-il is among the best-known haegeum players working today, here devoting a recital to the sanjo lineage of her teacher Kim Yeong-jae.

395623.title: Quiet Pungnyu I: Seo Yong-seok's Dam
395623.overview: Pungnyu is the older tradition of chamber music played among scholars for their own pleasure rather than for an audience — suited to this small hanok hall.

392773.title: Gugak Songs for Chuseok
392773.venue: Haneul Theater, National Theater of Korea
392773.overview: A holiday programme of gugak gayo — traditional-style songs written for modern audiences — timed for Chuseok, the Korean harvest festival.

396484.title: Yongsinje: Song for a Good Catch
396484.overview: Based on the dragon-god rite that fishing villages performed to pray for a safe and plentiful season.

393101.title: Dadam
393101.overview: A recurring National Gugak Center series pairing traditional music with tea and conversation.

396691.title: Gyeonggi Sinawi: For the Haegeum Melody
396691.overview: Sinawi is the improvised ensemble music that grew out of shamanic ritual in the southwest — closer to collective improvisation than to a fixed score.

380615.title: Jeongseon Arirang Festival
380615.overview: The 51st edition of the festival devoted to Jeongseon Arirang, the mountain-village variant of the folk song listed by UNESCO as Intangible Cultural Heritage. Held across the town each autumn.

392747.title: Surim New Wave 2026: Choi Tae-young, Bisabijuk

392737.title: Surim New Wave 2026: Lee Jae-ha, Geumjae — Double Translation

392774.title: Midday Concert: October
392774.venue: Haeoreum Theater, National Theater of Korea
392774.overview: A monthly lunchtime concert by the National Orchestra of Korea, priced and programmed for casual first-time audiences.

396054.title: Surim New Wave 2026: Lee Jun-hyung, Gilgut

392741.title: Changjak-ing: Kkokdugak, A Play of Time
392741.overview: New theatre drawing on kkokdugaksi noreum, Korea's traditional puppet play.

392776.title: Complete Pansori: October
392776.venue: Daloreum Theater, National Theater of Korea
392776.overview: One singer, one drummer, one full epic — the National Theater's monthly complete-pansori series.

391504.title: The Story of a Living Human Treasure: Jeong Sun-im
391504.overview: A portrait concert of Jeong Sun-im, a designated holder of pansori as national intangible heritage.
